newsitem.title: UK: Mackie says has had tentative bid approach.
newsitem.headline: Mackie says has had tentative bid approach.

text.p: British engineering firm Mackie International Group Plc said on Monday it had received a preliminary approach which may lead to a takeover offer.
It made the statment in an announcement to the London Stock Exchange, in which it noted the recent move in its share price.
"Any such offer may or may not be at a premium to the current Mackie share price of 160p," it added, saying a further announcement would be made in due course.
The company's shares traded up 9-1/2 pence at 159-1/2 pence on the day, steady at the level reached before the announcement.
